title: garuleum sonchifolium
intro: Garuleum sonchifolium, commonly known as a type of dandelion, is a flowering plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting liver health. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily due to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Garuleum sonchifolium include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
